params.prompt:
Commercial-quality modern high-density pixel-art life simulation set in a fictional contemporary Korean city.

2.5D three-quarter elevated top-down open-world game perspective, consistent camera angle, believable architectural depth, layered foreground and background, clear walkable gameplay space, realistic human-scale entrances, sidewalks, roads and interiors.

Crisp deliberate pixel edges, consistent pixel density, grounded proportions, rich environmental storytelling, restrained palette, muted urban colors, warm practical interior lighting and controlled city lights.

The world looks ordinary and believable at first glance, but contains understated black comedy about work, education, money, debt, rent, investing, consumption and adulthood.

The humor must come from context and environmental storytelling rather than exaggerated jokes.

Original visual identity for Ian Growing.

Not voxel.
Not block-based.
Not photorealistic.
Not glossy 3D.
Not generic mobile game art.
Not fantasy.
Not cyberpunk.
No real brands.
No readable AI-generated Korean text.
Leave signage text areas blank for hand-authored Unity pixel text.

Anchor the open-plan Korean company office to reference one's floor plan. Distinct workstations, monitor backs, one printer, cabinet, small glass meeting room, open pantry and coffee, broad aisle. Workers doing different jobs: typing, waiting for a print, quietly standing with a mug. By the pale peach wellness poster panel with a simple smiling sun icon a tired employee still types. Blank poster areas and screens with abstract blocks. Clean neutral corporate illumination. Use a shallow fixed orthographic game camera looking north, camera pitched down about 35 degrees, horizontal east-west edges across the frame; visible floor/top and south-facing walls, no horizon, no vanishing points. Characters about 6 heads tall; an entry is about 1.25 times standing height. Draw a single contiguous game view with open lanes; never a collage or HUD. Use small pixel clusters, asphalt slate, concrete putty, muted teal, warm oat, ink blue and restrained amber.
